C0546.title: Makeup Artist Detained After 1,036 Swapped Returns Totaling ¥890,000
C0546.summary: A makeup artist was placed under criminal detention for systematically exploiting return processes through product swapping, carrying out 1,036 fraudulent returns with a total involved amount of 890,000 yuan.
